title: Entry in accounts
html:
Entry in accounts

F.A.C. 52.

117. Pay, establishment and travelling allowance charges of divisional officers and their subordinates should be charged in the cash-book without further details, the entries being supported by the bills as vouchers, and the actual payees’ acknowledgments, in the case of payments to non-gazetted government servants who do not draw their own bills, being retained in the divisional office.
